# Carson Antiques & Collectibles Mall

> Northern Nevada's largest antique mall: over 21,000 square feet of numbered vendor booths at 1831 N Carson St, Carson City, NV 89701. Open every day, Monday through Sunday, 10 AM to 6 PM — Saturday and Sunday included. Phone (775) 461-3142.

## Visit
- Address: 1831 N Carson St, Carson City, NV 89701 — on North Carson Street, under the yellow sign. There's a parking lot in front.
- Hours: every day 10 AM–6 PM, Saturday and Sunday included. Holiday hours aren't posted — call (775) 461-3142 before a holiday trip.
- Phone: (775) 461-3142
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Carson%20Antiques%20%26%20Collectibles%20Mall%2C%201831%20N%20Carson%20St%2C%20Carson%20City%2C%20NV%2089701&destination_place_id=ChIJV4dzZtkKmYARQRRib-5tQW8
- Reno — 31 mi, about 40 min via I-580
- Sparks — 31 mi, about 40 min via I-580
- Carson Valley (Minden–Gardnerville) — 16–18 mi, about 30–35 min via US-395
- South Lake Tahoe — 30 mi, about 55 min via US-50
- Stateline — 26 mi, about 45 min via US-50
- Incline Village — 26 mi, about 50 min via NV-28 and US-50

## What it is
- A multi-vendor antique mall: different vendors stock the numbered booths, on two floors.
- Categories: Collectibles, Home Goods, China, Furniture, Artwork, Currency (coins). The sign out front also lists Gifts, Home Decor, Art, Toys & More.
- Not everything is antique: booths mix antiques, vintage, collectibles and newer home decor.
- The cashier is at the entrance.

## Nearby (from our front door)
- Children's Museum of Northern Nevada, 813 N Carson St — 0.6 mi south, about a 15-min walk
- Nevada State Museum (the old Carson City Mint), 600 N Carson St — 0.7 mi south, about a 15-min walk
- Nevada State Capitol, 101 N Carson St — 0.9 mi south, about a 20-min walk
- Carson Hot Springs Resort, 1500 Old Hot Springs Rd — 2 mi, about a 10-min drive
- Nevada State Railroad Museum, 2180 S Carson St — 2.2 mi south, about a 10-min drive
- Stewart Indian School Cultural Center & Museum, 1 Jacobsen Way — 5 mi south, about a 15-min drive

## Vendors
- Vendors rent the numbered booths. Booth rates aren't posted online — call (775) 461-3142 for current rates and availability.

## Ask the store
- Anything not listed here (booth rates, holiday hours, whether items are bought or appraised): call (775) 461-3142.
